newsitem.title: USA: UBS names global sector head of healthcare.
newsitem.headline: UBS names global sector head of healthcare.

text.p: UBS Securities said Tuesday that Jerome Brimeyer has joined the firm as global sector head of healthcare and will also serve as a pharmaceutical analyst.
Most recently, Brimeyer was with Lehman Brothers, where he worked since 1992.

As global sector head, Brimeyer will be principally responsible for coordinating UBS' healthcare analysts, both in the United States and abroad. In addition to his sector duties, Brimeyer will be working with Ken Kulju to expand UBS' pharmaceutical coverage.
UBS also said it is strengthening its healthcare team by formally creating global teams in biotechnology and medical technology, as part of an effort to expand and globalize these franchises.

Tim Wilson, who is moving to London, will become global sector head of biotechnology and will have coverage responsibility for both European and selected U.S. companies; Sam Navarro will become global sector head of medical technology.
UBS is a subsidiary of Union Bank of Switzerland.
